Name: Dark Club - Unofficial 1.6 Update
Author: sumaniBlack
Description:
[size=4]This is an unofficial update for the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11268]Dark Club[/url] mod from simezi21(thanks again for giving the okay) - if you like this go over there and endorse it.

[b]This mod will be available until simezi21 either tells me to take it down or updates the original mod.[/b]
Using this update will break all your items (they can still be sold), I'm fairly certain all your animals will be turned into cows and I'm not sure if machinery and decorations will survive - by the time I had a good enough handle on SV modding to understand what I was doing I had already deleted all the broken bits and pieces from the farm, so I don't know for sure what the update will do to them.
All content of the original mod should be accessible again (exceptions see below). The Sella event were she opens the dungeon once you have the skull key didn't trigger for me, but the dungeon was open anyways, so it's not that big of a deal, just annoying.

[size=4][size=4][b]Known issues[/b][/size][/size]
[list]
[*][size=4]There have been a bunch of complaints that Lilith's shop is not working. I added an image with details about when exactly the shop is working in the hopes that it will lessen the confusion. The main culprit here is me not being able to figure out how to get the CP shop system to show a "shop is closed" message during certain times. My experiments showed that either the shop is opened regardless or it doesn't show the message at all. And no, you can't open the shop from behind the counter. If you don't believe me try it in real life and see what happens.[/size]
[*][size=4]In (hopefully) rare cases Lilith and Sella seem to be registered twice. There will be an error message along the lines of "[game] NPC 'Lilith' in Data/Characters has former name 'Lilith', which can't be added because there's an NPC with that ID in Data/Characters." Should this occur try removing the line "FormerCharacterNames" from the lilith.json (in [CP] Dark Club\Characters\Lilith and Sella respectively. It worked before, but apparently you need to start a new day for the changes to have an effect. I do not understand why this can happen as I have both a completely new and a pre-1.6 save and both have the NPCs working fine.[/size]
[*][size=4]When reactivating the NPC schedule changes in the options the animations were not loaded correctly. I had to restart the game, but then it worked again as expected.[/size]
[/list][/size][size=4][size=4][b]Known issues (that probably won't be fixed)[/b][/size][/size]
[list]
[*][size=4]Dynamic Game Assets seem to be discontinued. That means there won't be any sounds for the decorations.[/size]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Upgrade hints[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][size=4]When upgrading from a version <2.7.0 to >=2.7.0 you need to remove the JA-Folder[/size]
[*][size=4]When upgrading to a version >=2.8.2 you need to delete the Folder [CC] Dark Club/Objects[/size]
[*][size=4]When upgrading to a version >=2.9.0: The small mods where moved under a Dark Club folder. This means you can delete your old folders if you didn't do this manually already. Remember that config files will be lost in this case, so you may want to move them first, if you did a lot of configuring and you don't want to do it again.[/size]
[*][size=4]When upgrading to a version >=2.12.0 Nude Farmer and Swimsuits has been replaced by an unofficial update. The AnimationFix was retired as it is a part of the unofficial update for NF&S[/size]
[*][size=4]When upgrading to a version >=2.13.0 you may delete the [SAAT] Dark Club folder. It doesn't matter if it stays, but it's no longer necessary.[/size]
[/list][size=4]
[size=4][b]Q&A[/b][/size] (read if you don't want to explore the mod yourself or are stuck)
Q: Where do I find <x>
A: The Dark Club. Nothing dark club specific will drop outside the Dark Club and the answer to your question is almost always "The dungeon and maybe the toilet (milk, semen and slave souls)."

Q: But where is the dungeon?
A: Behind Sella's prison. There is a sewer hatch on the far left of the prison map. You need to have the skull key for it to be accessible.

Q: But where is the prison??
A: In the Dark Club. If you can't find it, be there at about 8:10 and Sella will show you the way when she leaves Lilith's room in the back.

[b]I[/b][b]nstallation[/b]
1.Download and extract this mod and the Required Mods.
2.Put the extracted Mods into the \Stardew Valley\mods\ folder.
3.Launch the game and enjoy.
[/size]
